convergence_objective: Quantify scientifically interpretable calibration and confidence-geometry changes from retained polar-STF cross covariance in existing selected CF4 data; no assertion of statistical advantage over exact same-experiment GLS.

data_policy.allowed: Existing committed observation rows, covariance caches, masks, templates and already generated mocks; new computational Gaussian draws of these fixed declared models are allowed and must be labelled synthetic.
forbidden: Downloading new maps/catalogues or fabricating substitute observed data
Replacing a missing survey likelihood by a toy and reporting it as observed-data evidence
Inferring existence of a file from a legacy filename without reading it
data_policy.cache_policy: Preserve original cache bytes and model keys; operator-byte mismatch remains explicit and is accepted only under existing pinned numerical-parity policy.

statistical_model.formula: eta = nuisance + g(z) n.V + n.dH + n.K.n; X_m = O_m D, C_m = O_m C_noise O_m^T + pinned exact LCDM body

physical_pullback.status: conditional apparent-to-kinematic map with free calibration; sigma/omega/A individually unbounded
physical_pullback.beta_scope: specified constant-velocity response only, not arbitrary global tilt

five_views: x: signed vector/STF estimate with precision J, score t and full covariance
Q: gauge of the declared coefficient-noise ellipsoid K0
F: directional support; occupancy unavailable without admitted physical ceiling and measure
G_F: initial level plus full-covariance depth contrasts
statistical_model.view_combination: These views share one likelihood and must never be multiplied as independent evidence.

result_snapshot.calibration_scope: Fixed-design, fixed correctly specified covariance Gaussian parameter-error calibration; not empirical coverage of the real survey or cosmic covariance validation.

comparison_invariants: Same observed rows and row order
Same scientific target, units, frame and response
Same noise/cosmic covariance except explicitly labelled ablation
Same nuisance treatment and model family
Same declared masks, redshift/depth cuts and conditioning
Same training/calibration/evaluation partitions when learned components are compared
Observed sky/catalogue never reused as tuning labels without selection replay

comparators.method: Independent direct GLS and full multivariate Gaussian likelihood
comparators.common_estimand: Same 11 coefficient vector on same 32 rows with same covariance and response
comparators.evidence: Independent existing-data WLS reconstruction and direct GLS agree; separate 24 small-matrix log-likelihood checks max absolute error 1.0161e-12.
comparators.local_task: Reuse completed numerical evidence if code/input identity holds. On changed response/covariance rerun independent GLS oracle. Do not count identical statistical outputs as a WIN.
comparators.success: Numerical equality within declared conditioning-based tolerances.

comparators.evidence: F=X^T C^-1 X and t=X^T C^-1 y are the classical normal equations; the linear-mean Gaussian score is an affine transform of t.
metric: Fisher generalized eigenvalues on identified subspace
comparators.local_task: Produce an algebraic mapping to the classical score and a same-input check. Include covariance-derivative score terms only if covariance depends on fitted parameters.
comparators.success: State exact/local sufficiency scope; no extra-information claim relative to exact full likelihood.

comparators.method: Same response and marginal covariance, polar-STF cross covariance set to zero
comparators.common_estimand: Same 11 coefficient vector; covariance treatment is the sole ablation
comparators.evidence: Candidate Gaussian20k nominal95 coverage 0.93205-0.93560 versus full GLS 0.94960; independent Gaussian60k confirms approximately 0.93288-0.93728 versus 0.94972-0.95067.
metric: nominal vs actual variance generalized eigenvalues
best-fit displacement labelled descriptive, not a significance test
comparators.local_task: Preserve performed Gaussian calibration. Use any existing end-to-end catalogue mocks only after provenance/selection matching; report Gaussian and end-to-end results separately.
comparators.success: Quantify calibration gap with uncertainty and declare its conditional scope; no requirement that full covariance shrink every interval.

comparators.method: Legacy scalar x_c or scalar norm compression
comparators.common_estimand: Scalar norm cannot identify signed tensor/vector contrasts unless an extra direction assumption is supplied
comparators.evidence: Equal norms with different orientations can have different likelihood. The existing small counterexample establishes loss of orientation, not a universal power gain.
metric: coverage for genuinely common scalar targets only
comparators.local_task: Read the actual legacy statistic and map its target. Compare amplitudes only when the same null and normalization apply; do not invent a direction estimator for the scalar competitor.
comparators.success: Either comparable amplitude result with calibrated uncertainty, or explicit target mismatch.

comparators.common_estimand: Only a declared CMB anisotropy response on the same existing a_lm and MC ensemble
comparators.evidence: CF4 apparent Hubble coefficients and CMB covariance irreps are different experiments/targets; no common transfer response has been supplied by this R58 run.
metric: power for same injected CMB response if existing templates support it
comparators.local_task: Inventory already owned CMB coefficients/masks/MC and existing transfer templates. Reuse fixed analysis if present. If absent or ensemble cannot resolve the proposed test, write BLOCKED_EXISTING_INPUT or UNDERPOWERED_NOT_COMPARABLE and finish this lane without new download.
comparators.success: Common target must be justified before a WIN/TIE/WORSE label; a shared word anisotropy is insufficient.

comparators.method: Direct covariant dipole+STF cosmography/weighted distance regression
comparators.common_estimand: Same apparent low-z coefficients on the selected CF4 rows; true sigma/A require additional calibration restrictions
comparators.evidence: Same linear model reduces to direct GLS. Physical pullback with free calibration has rank11 in22; individual sigma/omega/A intervals are unbounded.
comparators.local_task: Freeze sign/units/source direction and residual definition. Compare exact same catalog/corrections. Higher-order redshift claims need existing source-bound response kernels; unsupported derivatives stay unresolved.
comparators.success: Report apparent measured quantities and identifiable mixtures separately from physical assumptions.

comparators.method: Independent aberration/Doppler estimators with intrinsic dipole and dipolar lensing nuisance
comparators.common_estimand: An explicit shared beta/local-observer target with specified CMB response and covariance
comparators.evidence: CF4 coherent V is not automatically the CMB observer velocity. Existing R58 uses constant velocity and does not implement evolving global-tilt transfer.
metric: confusion matrix from same declared injections
comparators.local_task: Use only existing source-bound boost/global-tilt templates. If a global template or independently calibrated CMB estimator is unavailable, report the model-specific unresolved degeneracy. Do not relabel V as a measured global tilt.
comparators.success: No separation claim without a distinguishable response and calibrated error law.

comparators.common_estimand: Class-specific transfer parameters with same data, nuisance and priors
comparators.evidence: Local STF eigenvalues do not determine spatial Lie-algebra class. R58 did not evaluate Bianchi transfer likelihoods.
metric: profile likelihood or Bayes factor only on common observation density
misclassification power if same existing mocks exist
comparators.local_task: Read existing Bianchi class registry, structure constants and templates. Evaluate only available validated classes; missing classes remain BLOCKED_EXISTING_INPUT. Do not manufacture a common estimand by renaming STF coefficients.
comparators.success: A local morphology label is never counted as a Bianchi-class measurement.

comparators.method: R7-R9 union confidence sets, max model p and unknown-dependence multiplicity correction
comparators.common_estimand: Common physical coefficient target under a declared finite nuisance family
comparators.evidence: Legacy robustness principles reused; the new empirical content is seven-model selected-CF4 confidence geometry.
metric: directions robust across all admitted models
comparators.local_task: Keep every model result and distinguish coordinate interval hull from disconnected set union. Do not rank differently transformed observation densities by raw likelihood/AIC/Bayes factors.
comparators.success: Coverage stated only if at least one declared model and its error law is valid.

freeze_before_run: Existing input checksums and baseline commit
Scientific target and null for each comparator
All seven current nuisance models; no observed-p-value pruning
Fixed comparison metrics and reporting table
Mock law, seeds, counts, stopping condition and provenance
execution_order: Reproduce existing R58 outputs only if identities changed or on the user local machine for environment verification
Reuse completed direct GLS and score equivalence evidence; run the portable independent checker against the native output
Reuse completed same-input full/split sandwich and Gaussian calibration; the checker replays the existing 60000-draw oracle without a new implementation
If suitable existing end-to-end survey mocks exist, rerun the unchanged pipeline across those mocks; this is the remaining unexecuted numerical benchmark
Classify the other comparators from existing evidence and common-target checks; do not implement unrelated competitors or new transfer models
Write all outcomes including ties, misses, blocked inputs and underpowered results
local_benchmark_protocol.no_new_data_stop: If a lane needs an unowned data product or a scientifically missing transfer map, record exact missing dependency and close it as blocked/unresolved; do not expand the data acquisition campaign.

mc_reporting.minimum: No universal minimum count is asserted. Use all declared existing mocks up to the predeclared cap, report binomial intervals and p resolution.
mc_reporting.p_resolution: 1/(N+1) for a standard add-one Monte Carlo p-value
mc_reporting.underpowered: If Monte Carlo uncertainty cannot distinguish claimed calibration/power difference or resolve target tail, use UNDERPOWERED_NOT_COMPARABLE.
mc_reporting.selection: Post hoc model/axis/cut selection must be replayed on each null mock before a global discovery claim; otherwise retain conditional C0.

local_benchmark_protocol.acceptance: A correctly reported TIE or NOT_COMPARABLE is acceptable. A claimed benefit requires the same target and calibrated uncertainty; never select a weaker competitor to force a win.

completed_numerical_evidence.scope: Fixed design and assumed full covariance; independent implementations and random seeds, not an independent observed catalogue or empirical survey calibration.

local_benchmark_protocol.remaining_unexecuted_numerical_benchmark: Existing end-to-end survey-mock replay with matched provenance and selection. If suitable mocks are absent, record the exact missing input and unresolved empirical coverage; finish the conditional manuscript without a new data acquisition or Gaussian-only substitute.

publication_decision.potential_novelty: Quantified polar-STF cross-covariance calibration fragility and nuisance-sensitive mixed confidence geometry on an existing selected CF4 catalogue, integrated with inherited five-view interpretation.
not_novel: More p-values from the same carrier
publication_decision.discovery_status: No unconditional anisotropy, acceleration, vorticity, Bianchi class or global-tilt detection established.
publication_decision.next_manuscript_claim: Conditional selected-CF4 mixed-kinematic likelihood and measurable coverage cost of block factorization; novelty must be assessed against closest same-estimand CF4 studies.
